investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on apexwellness.com/partners inside a partner tile that includes descriptive text indicating an integration. The domain is five years old and resolves to a hosting IP with an abuse score of 0/100, showing no known malicious infrastructure. Visual comparison shows high fidelity with the reference logo and the page layout appears to be a legitimate partner listing rather than a credential-harvesting or impersonation page. Given the established domain history, clean IP reputation, explicit partner labeling, and absence of prior malicious activity, this detection is assessed as Low Priority.
